finding_resolution: Owned child process is covered by finally immediately after Popen. It kills only the new-session group, tolerates ProcessLookupError, waits/reaps the direct child and records returncode. Outer BaseException records failures, and SIGTERM raises SystemExit so cleanup runs. The four requested interruption/failure paths now passed controlled process tests.

Corrected only the harness proxy and narrowed injected write failure to records with wrapper_pid. Failed log retained. No real model or runner could be launched because the only Popen implementation is the dummy substitute.
